blocks.text: Nitrification aur denitrification nitrogen cycle ke do marahil hain. Nitrification ammonium (NH4+) ko nitrite (NO2-) aur nitrate (NO3-) mein badalti hai, jabke denitrification nitrate ko nitrogen (N2) mein. Dono nitrogen hatane ke liye wastewater treatment mein bhi istemal hote hain (Table 12.3).

blocks.caption: Nitrification aur denitrification mein farq (Table 12.3)
rows: Ammonia / NH4+ nitrite aur nitrate mein badalta hai
Nitrite aur nitrate wapas N2 mein badalte hain, jo fiza mein chhor diya jata hai
Nitrifying bacteria, aerobic halaat, pH 6.5 se 8.0, behtareen 20 se 30 degrees C
Denitrifying bacteria, anaerobic halaat, pH 7.0 se 9.0, behtareen 26 se 38 degrees C
Paude yeh nitrites aur nitrates jazb karte hain, kyunke woh fiza ki nitrogen seedha istemal nahi kar sakte
Wastewater treatment mein aham aur aabi hayat ke liye mufeed (NH4+ NO2- se oxidise ho kar N2 gas)
Oxidation: NH4+ se NO2- se NO3-; 2NH4+ + 3O2 se 2NO2- + 4H+ + 2H2O; 2NO2- + O2 se 2NO3-
Reduction: NO3- se NO2- se NO se N2O se N2; 2NO3- + 10e- + 12H+ se N2 + 6H2O

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen ki oxidation state ki tabdeeli ke lihaz se nitrification aur denitrification mein farq batayein (MCQ VI).
blocks.explanation: Nitrification oxidation hai: nitrogen ammonium mein -3 se nitrite mein +3 aur nitrate mein +5 jati hai, aerobic bacteria se. Denitrification reduction hai: nitrogen nitrate mein +5 se nitrite, NO aur N2O se ho kar nitrogen gas mein 0 tak jati hai, anaerobic bacteria se.

items: Nitrification (aerobic bacteria, pH 6.5-8.0, 20-30 degrees C): NH4+ se NO2- se NO3-, paudon ki khurak. Denitrification (anaerobic, pH 7.0-9.0, 26-38 degrees C): NO3- se N2, nitrogen hawa ko wapas; dono wastewater treatment mein.
